top_signals.title: Taiwan’s Lai Urges Democracies to Unite After Trump-Xi Talks
top_signals.summary: Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te called on democracies in the region to unite against threats to stability, as the island faces pressure from Beijing and concerns that US President Donald Trump’s rapprochement with China could come at Taiwan’s expense.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Living with Mom and trading on margin. The regular investor gets in on Wall Street's record stock borrowing binge
top_signals.summary: Margin debt has surged to record levels as investors like 29-year-old Hy Luu borrow more against their portfolios. Here’s how leverage can amplify stock losses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
